frame_definition: One world advanced one simulation frame. Throughput = environments * step calls * frame_skip / measured wall seconds. No neural inference, PPO, rendering or frame limits. Timers exclude setup, warmup and sampled diagnostics.

core_amortization.caveat: Regression estimate on a straight-bullet steady-state scene; frame_skip changes observation frequency, not world-step size. Call term also contains Python/FFI/Rayon dispatch, not only observation encoding.

two_socket_shards.caveat: Independent process measurements overlap after a readiness barrier; this is summed concurrent throughput, not one batch latency.

verification.scope: Syntax and numerical invariants checked; measured installed engine directly. No production engine/model changes.
